summary: v10 §2 division-level visibility shipped, additive-only, with a bite-proof committed gate (250 assertions, exit 0). FILES: (1) src/state/store.ts (+195 lines, verified additive: `git diff -U0` shows zero deleted lines) — DIVISIONS (Prosencephalon=telencephalon+diencephalon, Mesencephalon=midbrain, Rhombencephalon=pons+cerebellum+medulla, Cerebral vasculature=vasculature), divisionRegions/divisionsOf/divisionLayersOn, pure applyDivisionLayers (UNION)/clearDivisionLayers/soloDivisionLayers/toggleDivisionLayers, a load-time assertion that the four divisions PARTITION ALL_REGIONS (each region in exactly one) with vasculature explicitly asserted as its own system, and four thin zustand actions applyDivision/clearDivision/toggleDivision/soloDivision that write ONLY layers.regions. NO new AtlasLayers field, no persistence key, and DEFAULT_LAYERS / VIEW_PRESETS / initialLayers / layersFromPreset / viewPresetOf are untouched (both closure-bite mutation anchors at store.ts `hidden: new Set(CORTEX_PRESET_IDS),` and `hidden: new Set(nonTelencephalonIds()),` still appear exactly 1× — counted in Node). (2) src/components/Legend.tsx — a 'Divisions' group inside the existing 'Layer toggles' group: one row per division built from DIVISIONS (never a hand-typed list), each with a real <input type=checkbox> (checked = divisionLayersOn, onChange = toggleDivision) and a real <button> Solo (soloDivision), each carrying data-division="<id>" + data-division-action, with accessible names 'Toggle the <division> division (regions)' and 'Show only the <division> division (regions)'. Palette rows, kind rows and per-region rows are byte-compatible (same .legend-row.legend-toggle / .is-on rule), so no existing assertion moved. (3) scripts/verify/division-toggles.mjs (new, 250 assertions) imports the SHIPPED store through an in-process TS/TSX loader (same technique as audit-checks.test.mjs) and proves: solo() leaves exactly one division's regions on and every other off (action + pure, printed per division); the checkbox path is a union that is idempotent, turns a complete division off, and restores the previous region set exactly; vasculature is never swept into a division (7×4 matrix printed); kinds/hidden/emphasis are set-equal after every call; a fresh boot still reports brainstem-focus with vasculature region off and every other region on; every region of every division is in ALL_REGIONS; a real React render yields 4 checkboxes + 4 solo buttons with distinct accessible names above the region rows; and — the bite half — four deliberately injected defects (assignment/partial/swept/clobber) are each caught by a named check, plus a mutated DIVISIONS table (arteries folded into the rhombencephalon) is run in an isolated copy of the tree and must trip the store's own load-time assertion (exit 1, message printed), and check 10 drives the shipped handlers in an isolated copy (hook-stubbed) capturing 7 states: boot [true,true,true,false] → solo(mesencephalon)=[midbrain] → checkbox off=[] → checkbox on=[midbrain] → vascular checkbox ±vasculature → solo(prosencephalon)=[diencephalon,telencephalon]. VERIFIED (all exit 0, numbers printed): npm run check; node scripts/verify/division-toggles.mjs (250 passed · 0 failed); npm run verify:audit-checks (92 passed · 0 failed); npm run verify:closure-bite (7/7 mutations caught, shared tree untouched, 92 passed restored) — one earlier run hit a transient EPERM deleting .plate-scratch/bite/tree while another agent's node process ran; the immediate re-run was green; npm run verify:a11y-contract (38 passed); verify:pip-contract; verify:boundary-contract; verify:plane (10 827 assertions); verify:somatotopy (45/45); verify:pipeline (138/138 parts · 599 204 tris · 386 loops · 0 problems); validate (0 errors/0 warnings); build (exit 0). NOT GREEN AND NOT MINE: verify:cortical-lobes (165/167 at the time of my sweep — fails on the in-flight task-4 edits to src/components/section/corticalLobes.ts + SectionCanvas.tsx, files I never touched); verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit stay RED at base (piped child stdio EPERM, PLAN.md §0); verify:acceptance/verify:audit need Chrome (not startable here) — the rendered pixels, the real pointer/keyboard click on these controls, and the browser audit's own legend reads (audit.mjs:1849/2115 query '.legend-row.legend-toggle' by exact text; the four division rows add no such row, so those predicates keep matching only the 'vasculature'/'vessel' kind+region rows) are ORCHESTRATOR-ONLY. DEVIATIONS from the brief: (a) TaxonomyTree.tsx was NOT modified — architecture PLAN.md §2/§10.6 and PLAN.md §6 remove it from the task's writes because solo already dims the tree through the existing layerOff() rule; (b) the brief lists package.json as untouched — the integrator must add "verify:division-toggles": "node scripts/verify/division-toggles.mjs" (PLAN.md §6 line 319).
